queries.query: large language model network configuration generation "intent to configuration" "NetOps" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Discover empirical and methodological work where LLMs translate operator intent or NL intents into network configurations (phenomenon: LLM-generated configs).
Find work and mechanisms where generation is combined with validators or iterative repair loops to fix buggy configs (mechanisms & mitigations).
Survey agentic and tool-enabled architectures that allow LLMs to call validators, simulators, or execution tools (mechanisms, orchestration).
source_preferences: industrial white papers with reproducible artifacts

queries.query: network configuration verification "header space analysis" "NetPlumber" "configuration verifier"
queries.rationale: Locate formal/deterministic verification tools and methods employed to check reachability, policy compliance, and safety of network configs (benchmark validity & validators).

queries.query: bounded generation constraint decoding "constrained decoding" "LLM filters" "safety filter" "post-hoc validation"
queries.rationale: Collect methods that constrain or filter LLM outputs to improve operational safety (mitigations and defenses).

queries.query: benchmarks for LLMs in networking "NetOps benchmark" "configuration benchmark" "AIOps benchmark" "TSNBench" "6G-Bench" "OpsEval"
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmark suites and evaluation practices for LLMs/AIOps in networking to assess validity and gaps (benchmark validity).

queries.query: failure modes LLMs for operational tasks "hallucination" "omission" "incomplete specification" "unsafe network change"
queries.rationale: Survey documented failure modes when LLMs perform operational tasks, with emphasis on safety-critical consequences (phenomenon & failure analysis).
source_preferences: industry incident reports with public details

queries.query: adversarial prompts robustness LLM network tasks "prompt injection" "adversarial examples"
queries.rationale: Find studies that test robustness of LLM-driven NetOps under adversarial or perturbed inputs (robustness mechanisms & threat modelling).

queries.query: human-in-the-loop verification NetOps LLM "operator oversight" "human approval" "explainability"
queries.rationale: Gather work on HCI and human oversight designs for operator acceptance, explanations and safe rollouts of automated NetOps changes (mitigations & operational procedure).

queries.query: network simulation and emulation environments for configuration testing "Mininet" "ns-3" "GNS3" "containerized lab"
queries.rationale: List evaluation platforms and methods to execute and validate generated configurations in simulated/emulated environments (methods & reproducible evaluation).

queries.query: operational correctness metrics for network configurations "reachability" "connectivity" "policy compliance" "route convergence" "safety metric"
queries.rationale: Capture metric definitions and measurement techniques that reflect operational correctness and safety for NetOps experiments (benchmark validity & metrics).

queries.query: prompting strategies constrained generation for operational tasks "system prompt" "few-shot" "chain of thought" "plan-and-execute"
queries.rationale: Survey prompting techniques and their effect on correctness and reliability when generating operational artifacts (methods & prompts sensitivity).

queries.query: orchestration frameworks for LLM agents "LangChain" "AutoGPT" "ReAct" "toolformer" "agentic pipelines"
queries.rationale: Collect literature and engineering artifacts describing orchestrators used to build multi-step agentic NetOps workflows (methods & neighbor work).
source_preferences: industrial engineering blog posts with code

queries.query: AIOps automated troubleshooting network diagnosis "root cause analysis" "fault localisation" "automated remediation"
queries.rationale: Locate related non-LLM AIOps research on automated diagnosis and remediation to position LLM approaches relative to prior automated NetOps work (neighbouring work & baselines).

queries.query: ethics safety reliability autonomous operational agents "operational risk" "incident analysis" "governance"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on governance, safety engineering, and ethical considerations for deploying autonomous agents in operational environments (threats, mitigations, disclosure practices).

inclusion_criteria: Empirical studies or reproducible artifacts (code, datasets, simulators) relevant to LLM/AI for NetOps
Papers describing validators, formal verification, or explicit metrics for network configuration correctness or safety
Work on agentic or tool-assisted LLM architectures applied to operational tasks
Benchmarks, datasets, or systematic evaluations for AIOps/NetOps or LLM-driven operations
Studies of failure modes, robustness, adversarial attacks, or human-in-the-loop safeguards pertinent to operational reliability
Simulation/emulation platforms or experimental methods that enable executing and validating generated network configs
Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints, RFCs, or well-documented project repositories) with verifiable metadata
exclusion_criteria: Pure NLP studies without an operational NetOps application or without concrete mapping to network config/actions
Opinion pieces, unreferenced blog claims, or marketing material lacking reproducible evidence (unless they provide code/datasets for verification)
Proprietary internal incident reports or private datasets not publicly accessible
Works focused exclusively on model pretraining or broad LLM capabilities without NetOps-specific evaluation or methods
Benchmarks that only test trivia/knowledge about networking without execution/verification of produced configurations
date_rationale: Prioritize recent work (approx. 2018–2026) to capture post-LLM advances while including seminal earlier verification and NetOps work (e.g., header-space analysis) as needed. For each candidate source verify title, authors, venue/year, and primary artifact (DOI/arXiv/RFC/GitHub) before inclusion.
